name: XAUUSD_CANDLE_PATTERN_CONTINUATION

entry_rules.hypothesis: Candle-pattern continuation. Unlike V1-V5 (structure-break/BOS), V6 uses engulfing doji patterns as entry signals, confirmed by M15 ADX strength and EMA trend alignment. The pattern fires on the M5 trigger bar; direction follows the pattern type (bullish engulfing -> BUY, bearish engulfing -> SELL).

bias_filters.trend_alignment: price > EMA for BUY, price < EMA for SELL (optional)

entry_trigger.bullish_entry: bullish engulfing pattern on M5 bar
entry_trigger.bearish_entry: bearish engulfing pattern on M5 bar

description: V6: candle-pattern continuation. Uses M5 engulfing patterns as entry signals, confirmed by M15 ADX(14)>=25 and EMA alignment. ATR(14) 1.5x stop, 2.5R target. London/NY sessions only.

research_results.hypothesis: Engulfing candlestick patterns with ADX+EMA confirmation generate continuation momentum on M5 XAUUSD.
research_results.conclusion: NO EDGE. Even with fresh candle-pattern signals (engulfing, doji) confirmed by ADX+EMA, win rate is 4-7%. PF 0.02-0.03. MC fails with 100% ruin probability. 6 strategies tested (V1 trend-long, V2 trend-both, V3 MR-fade, V4 range-MR-fade, V5 momentum-continuation, V6 candle-pattern). ALL show PF=0.00-0.04 — no statistical edge.

notes: Research script: research/v6_candle_pattern.py — no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (XAUUSD M15: 47398 bars, M5: 35797 bars). Broker timezone UTC+3. M5 data covers Feb 2025 to Aug 2026 (~6 months).
